name: normalGrid
blurb: Masonry grid of project cards with staggered fade-in on scroll.
description: A CSS columns-based masonry layout displaying project cards with images, titles, and descriptions. Cards animate in with stagger when scrolled into view via motion/react.
use_when: Portfolio pages, case study galleries, or project showcases with natural column wrapping.
avoid_when: When dynamic or custom project data is needed; this is a demo template with hardcoded content.
a11y: Semantic article elements; fade-in animations triggered by scroll viewport intersection.
